$comment: Copy to theme.json to rebrand Cortex (gitignored). Pick a theme in the UI (Settings -> Theme) or edit here. themeId selects a built-in preset (see app/lib/themes.ts). brand.name + brand.logo are the fixed identity; tagline + colors are themeable. brand.logo is a path under public/. colors override Tailwind @theme tokens by name (no --color- prefix).
